说明: 严格微调对比看基础模型与 LoRA；API 教师仅作能力上限参考。

典型错误.问题: 列出退款中的订单编号、日期和金额
典型错误.期望SQL: SELECT order_id, order_date, total_amount FROM orders WHERE status = '退款中' ORDER BY order_date;
典型错误.预测SQL: SELECT o.order_id, o.order_date, o.total_amount FROM orders AS o INNER JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'refunded';

典型错误.问题: 统计每位用户有多少个订单，没有订单的用户也要显示
典型错误.期望SQL: SELECT u.name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count FROM users u LEFT JOIN orders o ON u.user_id = o.user_id GROUP BY u.user_id, u.name ORDER BY order_count DESC, u.user_id;
典型错误.预测SQL: SELECT u.user_id, COUNT(o.order_id) AS num_orders FROM users u LEFT JOIN orders o ON u.user_id = o.user_id GROUP BY u.user_id;

典型错误.问题: 统计各商品分类累计卖出的件数
典型错误.期望SQL: SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity) AS sold_quantity FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY sold_quantity DESC;
典型错误.预测SQL: SELECT p.category, COUNT(i.item_id) AS sold_count FROM products p JOIN order_items i ON p.product_id = i.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY sold_count DESC;

典型错误.问题: 按月份统计已完成订单数
典型错误.期望SQL: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(order_date, '%Y-%m') AS order_month, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE status = '已完成' GROUP BY order_month ORDER BY order_month;
典型错误.预测SQL: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(order_date, '%Y-%m') AS month, COUNT(*) AS completed_orders FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed' GROUP BY month;

典型错误.问题: 找出订单总金额超过 500 元的用户
典型错误.期望SQL: SELECT u.name, SUM(o.total_amount) AS total_spend FROM users u JOIN orders o ON u.user_id = o.user_id GROUP BY u.user_id, u.name HAVING total_spend > 500 ORDER BY total_spend DESC;
典型错误.预测SQL: SELECT u.name FROM users u INNER JOIN orders o ON u.user_id = o.user_id WHERE o.total_amount > 500;

典型错误.问题: 找出订单总金额超过 500 元的用户
典型错误.期望SQL: SELECT u.name, SUM(o.total_amount) AS total_spend FROM users u JOIN orders o ON u.user_id = o.user_id GROUP BY u.user_id, u.name HAVING total_spend > 500 ORDER BY total_spend DESC;
典型错误.预测SQL: SELECT u.name FROM users u JOIN orders o ON u.user_id = o.user_id WHERE o.total_amount > 500 ORDER BY u.name;

典型错误.问题: 统计每个商品出现在多少个不同订单中
典型错误.原始输出: {"sql":"SELECT p.product_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY order_count DESC;"}

典型错误.问题: 计算每个商品的库存金额并按金额降序排列
典型错误.期望SQL: SELECT product_name, price * stock AS stock_value FROM products ORDER BY stock_value DESC;
典型错误.预测SQL: SELECT p.product_name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_revenue FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

典型错误.问题: 统计每位用户有多少个订单，没有订单的用户也要显示
典型错误.期望SQL: SELECT u.name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count FROM users u LEFT JOIN orders o ON u.user_id = o.user_id GROUP BY u.user_id, u.name ORDER BY order_count DESC, u.user_id;
典型错误.预测SQL: SELECT u.user_id, u.name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count FROM users u LEFT JOIN orders o ON u.user_id = o.user_id GROUP BY u.user_id, u.name;

典型错误.问题: 按月份统计已完成订单数
典型错误.期望SQL: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(order_date, '%Y-%m') AS order_month, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE status = '已完成' GROUP BY order_month ORDER BY order_month;
典型错误.预测SQL: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(order_date, '%Y-%m') AS month, COUNT(*) AS completed_order_count FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month;

典型错误.问题: 找出订单总金额超过 500 元的用户
典型错误.期望SQL: SELECT u.name, SUM(o.total_amount) AS total_spend FROM users u JOIN orders o ON u.user_id = o.user_id GROUP BY u.user_id, u.name HAVING total_spend > 500 ORDER BY total_spend DESC;
典型错误.预测SQL: SELECT u.user_id, u.name, SUM(o.total_amount) AS total_spent FROM orders o JOIN users u ON o.user_id = u.user_id GROUP BY u.user_id, u.name HAVING SUM(o.total_amount) > 500;

典型错误.问题: 统计每个商品出现在多少个不同订单中
典型错误.期望SQL: SELECT p.product_name, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS order_count FROM products p LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY order_count DESC, p.product_id;
典型错误.预测SQL: SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS order_count FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY order_count DESC;

典型错误.问题: 计算已完成订单里每个商品的销售额
典型错误.期望SQL: SELECT p.product_name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = '已完成' GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY revenue DESC;
典型错误.预测SQL: SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS sales_amount FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.status = '已完成' GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name;
